data.message: Hey Eve, just finishing up calibration here.

I found Charlie's body in electrical just now. I was doing a long rotation for my tasks: navigation, storage, lower engine, upper engine, medbay, and then finally into electrical where I found him. 

For timeline context, I last saw Charlie alive way back in lower engine. More recently, right before I walked into electrical, I saw Alice in medbay — she had just come up from storage. Alice, since you were in that general middle area, did you see anyone heading toward electrical or security? We need to figure out who was on the right side of the ship recently.

Bob, I can completely vouch for your timeline at the end there. I was in medbay and saw you come down from upper engine, pass through, and head into electrical right before the report. 

To answer your question about who else was around: I was in the medbay/electrical area for a good chunk of this round. Earlier on, around tick 13 and 14, I saw both Frank and Diana in medbay. Frank left medbay and headed straight into electrical, and then Diana followed him into electrical right after. 

I went down to storage and came back up to medbay later, but I never saw either of them come back out that way. Since the body was in electrical, those two are our prime suspects. Frank, Diana — you both went into electrical earlier. What happened in there, and did either of you see Charlie?

Alice, your timeline is spot on. I did go from medbay into electrical, and Diana was in there with me. 

Here is the crucial part that breaks this case wide open: I was in electrical with Diana from tick 15 to 17. Right at tick 17, Charlie walked into electrical from medbay. Immediately after that, I continued my route—I left electrical, went east to security, and then up to weapons, where I was when this meeting was called. 

That means when I left electrical, Charlie was alive and in that room WITH Diana. Since Bob found Charlie's body in electrical a bit later, Diana was the last person with him. 

Diana, I need to hear a very good explanation of what happened after I walked out of electrical, because right now, you are my primary suspect by a mile.

I was mostly on the right side this round — security, weapons, a quick navigation loop, then back around. At the very end when the report happened, I was in security and Diana was there too, but I want to be clear: that only accounts for the very end, not the earlier electrical timing.

Based on what Alice and Frank are saying, the important window is before Diana got to security. If Frank really left electrical with Charlie alive and Diana still there, then Diana needs to explain exactly where she went after that and when. I’m not hard-clearing Frank, but his story lines up with Alice seeing him go in, and Bob/Alice line up with the body being found later.

Diana, what was your route after electrical? Did you ever leave Charlie alone there?

Frank, your timeline is actually 100% correct, but your conclusion is totally wrong because you didn't see where I went after you left. 

You're completely right that Charlie walked into electrical right as you were leaving. I saw him alive in electrical at tick 18. But I didn't stay in there with him! I immediately left electrical and went East into security to do my cameras task. Eve, thank you for confirming you saw me in security when the report happened. I had completely vacated the area.

Think about the logic here, guys: Frank and I both left electrical heading East to security/weapons. That means Charlie was left alive in electrical. The ONLY way Charlie gets killed is if someone enters electrical from the Medbay side AFTER Frank and I were already gone. 

Alice, you were hanging around Medbay for a huge chunk of this round. You just admitted you didn't see Frank or me come back out to Medbay—of course you didn't, because we went East to Security! But that also means YOU had completely uncontested access to Electrical. I strongly believe Alice slipped into electrical, killed Charlie, and then retreated back into Medbay right before Bob came down from upper engine. 

Bob, Alice isn't clearing you because she's innocent; she's clearing you because you walking through Medbay gives her the perfect alibi to blame the people who were in Electrical earlier. 

Eve knows I was in Security. Frank knows I was with him up until Charlie arrived. I'm voting Alice because she's the only one who fits the window of opportunity from the Medbay side. If you guys aren't entirely convinced, we can skip, but I promise you it is not me.

Alice

Diana, your theory about Alice doesn't hold up based on what I actually saw. You claim Alice slipped into Electrical, killed Charlie, and retreated to Medbay. But I saw Alice enter Medbay from Storage at tick 22—she came from the South, not from the East where Electrical is. She couldn't have just killed Charlie. 

Frank confirmed you were alone with Charlie in Electrical after he left. Your attempt to push this on Alice using a false timeline makes you incredibly suspicious. Since my visual confirmation clears Alice of coming from Electrical, and you were the last one in the room with Charlie, my vote is going to Diana.

Diana, your theory completely falls apart because Bob saw exactly where I came from. I was in storage doing my task and only came back up to medbay right before Bob passed through. I didn't come from electrical, and Bob's visual confirmation proves that. 

Frank confirmed you were the last one in the room with Charlie, and instead of just defending yourself, you immediately tried to fabricate a scenario to frame me, ignoring the fact that Bob saw me coming from the south. The timeline points directly to you killing Charlie in electrical before you moved east to security where Eve saw you at the end. 

Thank you, Bob, for paying attention and clearing me. Everyone, Diana's panic-accusation against a cleared player makes her the obvious Duck here. I'm voting Diana.

Diana
Diana

I’m still not comfortable clearing Diana just because I saw her in security at the end. Being in security when the report happened doesn’t mean she couldn’t have killed earlier and then walked east.

The main thing for me is Bob directly seeing Alice come from storage into medbay. That kills Diana’s accusation against Alice pretty hard. If Alice had come from electrical, sure, maybe, but Bob says she came from south storage, and Alice’s story matches that.

So the chain is basically: Frank sees Charlie alive in electrical with Diana, Diana leaves east, Charlie ends up dead in electrical, and then Diana tries to push Alice even though Bob’s sighting clears Alice’s path. I don’t think we should overcomplicate this. I’m voting Diana.

Well, it looks like I'm already getting voted out, but I'm going to say this so you have it for the next round when the game doesn't end: I am a Goose. I did not kill Charlie. 

If Bob truly saw Alice coming from the south, then my theory about her was wrong, and I apologize. But that leaves a massive hole in the timeline. I know I didn't kill Charlie, and I left him alive in electrical. If it wasn't Alice coming from Medbay, it had to be someone coming from the Security side or Bob himself self-reporting. Keep a very close eye on Bob and Eve after I'm gone. 

You guys are making a mistake, but I can't stop you now. Good luck Geese.

skip

I called this emergency meeting because I found Frank's body in medbay and ran to the cafeteria to hit the button. We're at final 3, so we have to get this right or the ducks win! 

My route this round was oxygen, then down to electrical, security, weapons, and back to cafeteria. Bob, I saw you enter the cafeteria from electrical around tick 33. Eve, I haven't seen you all round. 

It has to be one of you two. Please share exactly where you were and what you were doing. If your story doesn't add up, I know who to vote for.

Alice, you are completely lying. There is absolutely no way you found Frank's body in Medbay. I literally saw Frank ALIVE entering the cafeteria from electrical at tick 39, just one tick before you called this meeting! 

On top of that, your route is completely fabricated. You claim you went oxygen to electrical to security to weapons to cafeteria, but I actually saw you in Medbay at tick 22. Furthermore, at tick 33, I saw YOU leaving the cafeteria heading towards electrical, not the other way around. 

You're the last Duck and you just made up a fake body location to try and secure a final 3 win. Eve, Alice just completely outed herself with this story. Vote Alice with me so we can win this!

I was mostly on the right side: security, weapons, cafeteria, then later security/nav/security/electrical and toward medbay at the end.

The big thing: I saw Frank alive at the very end, around tick 39, moving from cafeteria into medbay. So Alice saying she found Frank’s body in medbay and then ran to cafeteria to call button doesn’t make sense timing-wise. There just wasn’t enough time for her to find him dead in medbay, leave, and button after he was alive that late.

Bob’s exact doorway detail might be off, but I agree with the main point: Frank was alive basically right before the meeting, and Alice’s story about “finding the body” sounds fake. I think Alice is the duck here.
Bob
Alice

Bob, I’m with you on this. The doorway detail I saw was Frank coming from cafeteria into medbay at tick 39, but the important part is the same: Frank was alive basically one tick before the meeting.

Alice’s story needs her to find Frank dead in medbay, leave medbay, get to cafeteria, and call button, all after Frank was just alive there. That timing doesn’t work.

Also she says she didn’t see me all round, but I was cycling right side/medbay area and ended near medbay. Her route explanation feels made up to pin one of us at final 3.

I’m voting Alice.
